## Description

Every change in quantity is a movement (receive, use, adjust, transfer between locations) with a reason, a person and a time. The on-hand quantity is the sum of movements, never edited directly.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** On-hand equals the sum of movements, tested under concurrent use.
- [ ] **AC2.** An adjustment needs a reason; adjustments are on the audit log.
- [ ] **AC3.** A transfer moves the same batch between two locations in one step.

## Notes / open questions

- Pick up from DentalERP: `StockTransaction` types. Do not copy its direct quantity update; Medvya uses an append-only ledger.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
